title: GHSL AI-agent index lists path traversal in 7-Zip SDK sample extractor
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: The 7zDec sample extractor’s extraction loop did not validate archive entry paths, allowing a crafted 7z member path to traverse outside the chosen extraction directory and overwrite a writable file.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index lists this 7-Zip advisory as discovered with AI agents; the individual disclosure credits Jaroslav Lobačevski but does not describe an agent or item-level AI contribution. The named system/model is therefore unknown; no claim of independent AI discovery is made.
classification_note: The cited sources document the issue and fix but do not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in 7-Zip v26.01 released 2026-04-27. GHSL identifies this as the SDK sample application rather than assigning a CVE; the release scope is described in the GHSL advisory.
